stages.name: Pilot
stages.stack: One laptop or VM, local models, PostgreSQL

stages.name: Seed
stages.stack: Managed PostgreSQL with row-level security, object store, job queue, one region

stages.name: Scale
stages.stack: Stateless API replicas, autoscaled workers, read replicas, per-tenant keys, nightly retrain

cost_note: The 1,000-student point is the finance model's INR 3.6. The 10k and 100k points are projections by line item (fixed lines shrink, WhatsApp does not). WhatsApp price per message is unverified.

failure_modes.response: Phone app queues scans and attendance, syncs later
Quality check asks for a retake; manual entry fallback
Flagged by item statistics; teacher confirms
Shows 'not enough data', never a number
Verified template report is sent instead
